title: ImageVersion now indicates Development Mode support
summary: The `ImageVersion` schema in Cloud Composer now includes a `devModeSupported` boolean property. This allows developers to programmatically check if a specific image version supports creating environments in `DEVELOPMENT` mode.
details: A new boolean property, `devModeSupported`, has been added to the `ImageVersion` schema. This property indicates whether it's possible to create a Cloud Composer environment in `DEVELOPMENT` mode using that particular image version. This provides more granular information for environment provisioning workflows.
